name: Phyresis
description: The Phyrexian oil-based transformation that reshapes minds and bodies.

timeline.summary: Vraska narrates being compleated: her throat and tendrils turn to metal, she petrifies Phyrexian agents until she is overwhelmed, and her self retreats into a hidden corner of her mind.
timeline.quote: I writhed and arched my back as Phyrexian oil rushed past my teeth.

timeline.summary: On the beach in his mind, Jace commands his body to fight the oil as a virus.
timeline.quote: THE OIL IN YOUR VEINS IS A VIRUS.

pages_say.description: The process of Phyrexian infection by glistening oil.
Phyrexian corruption that overtook Karn and which Elspeth was horrified by.
Phyrexian transformation that turns Vraska to metal and floods her with oil.
The spreading taint of Phyrexia that Zegana sought to cure.
The Phyrexian oil-based transformation that reshapes minds and bodies.
The Phyrexian transformation that Jace and Vraska fight off.
